title: Inflation is back: India’s climb from record lows
dek: Retail inflation fell to its lowest ever in late 2025. Within a year it was above 5% again. Here is how it happened.

glance.what: Retail inflation rose to 5.54% in September 2026, with food inflation at 7.74%. A year earlier it was close to zero.
glance.why: Higher prices for food and fuel squeeze household budgets, and rising inflation pushed the RBI into its first rate hike since 2023.
glance.next: October’s figure is released on 12 November 2026. ICRA expects it to cross 6% (a forecast).

forYou: Food and fuel are driving the rise, so household grocery and transport bills feel it first. Rural inflation is running higher than urban.
next: October data out 12 Nov. ICRA expects about 6.1% (forecast).

events.title: Inflation falls to a record low of 0.25%
events.summary: October 2025 retail inflation hits the lowest level of the current CPI series, helped by GST rate cuts and falling food prices.

events.title: Prices start to turn
events.summary: November inflation rises to 0.71%, led by food and fuel.

events.title: January inflation climbs to 2.75%
events.summary: The highest reading since May 2025, as the low base from late 2025 starts to fade.

events.title: August inflation at 4.8%, above the RBI’s 4% target
events.summary: Higher food prices push inflation above the target for a fourth month running. The figure was later revised to 4.83%.

events.title: RBI hikes rates and raises its inflation forecast
events.summary: The RBI raises the repo rate to 5.50% and lifts its 2026-27 inflation projection to 5.2% from 5%.

events.title: September inflation jumps to 5.54%
events.summary: Food inflation climbs to 7.74%. Rural inflation, at 6.08%, runs well above urban inflation at 4.88%.
events.differs: Swarajya calls 5.54% a 22-month high; Deccan Herald calls it a 23-month high.

events.title: Economists expect October to cross 6%
events.summary: ICRA forecasts October inflation at 6.1%, above the top of the RBI’s 2–6% tolerance band, partly because of a low base a year earlier.
